name: Shinohara Yuuri
source:
He is the son of the famous fashion brand "Shinohara." Even so, he is kind-hearted and not arrogant.

He seems to be popular if he is not talking, but he is actually not good with girls to the point of not speaking properly when interacting with them.

"What are you going to do if the next president of Shinohara can't even talk with the girls?"

At the behest of the current Shinohara president (mother), he ended up going to Magnolia Girls' Academy with his status and gender hidden.

[Translated from [url=https://www.moon-stone.jp/product/ms20/chara.html#yuuri]official website[/url]]
